name: AdminForge – Admin Management Toolkit
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Admin Toolkit helps you simplify and secure wp-admin without touching theme files.

Main Features

  • Admin menu control (hide menu items per role)
  • Dashboard widget manager (hide core dashboard widgets per role)
  • Admin UI customization (custom footer text, hide front-end admin bar per role)

Usage

  • Go to Settings → AdminForge – Admin Management Toolkit
  • Configure using the tabs:
    • Admin menu control
    • Dashboard widgets
    • Admin UI customization

Uninstall

When you delete the plugin from WordPress, it removes its saved options (afamt_options).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/ or copy it into place.
  2. Activate Admin Toolkit in Plugins.
  3. Go to Settings → Admin Toolkit (or click Settings on the Plugins page).
sections.faq:
Can this lock me out of wp-admin?

No. The free version does not include wp-admin access restriction settings.

Does it remove plugin-added dashboard widgets?

The built-in Dashboard widget toggles target core widget IDs. Plugin-added widgets may require custom IDs.
